description: Use parentheses, brackets, or braces in numerical expressions, and evaluate expressions with these symbols.
skill list: U4 Order of Operations with Grouping Symbols

description: Write simple expressions that record calculations with numbers, and interpret numerical expressions without evaluating them.
skill list: U4 Writing Numerical Expressions; U4 Interpreting Expressions Without Evaluating

description: Generate two numerical patterns using two given rules; identify relationships between corresponding terms; form and graph ordered pairs.
skill list: U4 Generating Numerical Patterns; U4 Relationships Between Two Patterns; U9 Graphing Patterns and Relationships

description: Recognize that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 10 times as much as it represents in the place to its right and 1/10 of what it represents in the place to its left.
skill list: U1 Place Value Patterns

description: Explain patterns in the number of zeros of the product when multiplying a number by powers of 10, and patterns in the placement of the decimal point; use whole-number exponents to denote powers of 10.
skill list: U1 Powers of Ten and Exponents; U7 Metric Conversions

description: Read and write decimals to thousandths using base-ten numerals, number names, and expanded form.
skill list: U1 Reading and Writing Decimals

description: Compare two decimals to thousandths based on meanings of the digits in each place, using >, =, and < symbols.
skill list: U1 Comparing and Ordering Decimals

description: Use place value understanding to round decimals to any place.
skill list: U1 Rounding Decimals

description: Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm.
skill list: U2 Multiplying Multi-Digit Whole Numbers; U2 Estimating Products and Quotients

description: Find whole-number quotients of whole numbers with up to four-digit dividends and two-digit divisors, using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between multiplication and division.
skill list: U2 Estimating Products and Quotients; U2 Dividing by One-Digit Divisors; U2 Dividing by Two-Digit Divisors; U2 Interpreting Remainders in Word Problems

description: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide decimals to hundredths, using concrete models or drawings and strategies based on place value.
skill list: U3 Adding and Subtracting Decimals; U3 Multiplying Decimals by Whole Numbers; U3 Multiplying Decimals by Decimals; U3 Dividing Decimals by Whole Numbers; U3 Dividing by Decimals; U3 Decimal Word Problems and Money; U11 Multi-Step Problem Solving

description: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators (including mixed numbers) by replacing given fractions with equivalent fractions.
skill list: U5 Equivalent Fractions and Common Denominators; U5 Adding Fractions with Unlike Denominators; U5 Subtracting Fractions with Unlike Denominators; U5 Adding and Subtracting Mixed Numbers

description: Solve word problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions referring to the same whole; use benchmark fractions and number sense to estimate and assess reasonableness.
skill list: U5 Estimating with Benchmark Fractions; U5 Fraction Word Problems; U11 Solving Problems with Line Plot Data; U11 Multi-Step Problem Solving

description: Interpret a fraction as division of the numerator by the denominator; solve word problems involving division of whole numbers leading to answers in the form of fractions or mixed numbers.
skill list: U6 Fractions as Division

description: Interpret the product (a/b) × q as a parts of a partition of q into b equal parts; equivalently, as the result of a sequence of operations a × q ÷ b.
skill list: U6 Multiplying a Fraction by a Whole Number; U6 Multiplying Fractions by Fractions

description: Find the area of a rectangle with fractional side lengths by tiling it with unit squares of the appropriate unit fraction side lengths, and show that the area is the same as would be found by multiplying the side lengths.
skill list: U6 Area with Fractional Side Lengths

description: Interpret multiplication as scaling: compare the size of a product to the size of one factor on the basis of the size of the other factor, without performing the indicated multiplication.
skill list: U6 Multiplication as Scaling

description: Explain why multiplying by a fraction greater than 1 results in a product greater than the given number, and by a fraction less than 1 in a product smaller than the given number; relate to equivalence a/b = (n × a)/(n × b).
skill list: U6 Multiplication as Scaling

description: Solve real-world problems involving multiplication of fractions and mixed numbers.
skill list: U6 Multiplying Fractions by Fractions; U6 Fraction Multiplication and Division Word Problems; U11 Solving Problems with Line Plot Data

description: Interpret division of a unit fraction by a non-zero whole number, and compute such quotients.
skill list: U6 Dividing Unit Fractions and Whole Numbers

description: Interpret division of a whole number by a unit fraction, and compute such quotients.
skill list: U6 Dividing Unit Fractions and Whole Numbers

description: Solve real-world problems involving division of unit fractions by non-zero whole numbers and division of whole numbers by unit fractions.
skill list: U6 Fraction Multiplication and Division Word Problems

description: Convert among different-sized standard measurement units within a given measurement system, and use these conversions in solving multi-step, real-world problems.
skill list: U7 Customary Length Conversions; U7 Customary Weight and Capacity Conversions; U7 Metric Conversions; U7 Multi-Step Measurement Problems; U11 Multi-Step Problem Solving

description: Make a line plot (dot plot) to display a data set of measurements in fractions of a unit; use operations on fractions to solve problems involving information presented in line plots.
skill list: U11 Reading Line Plots with Fractions; U11 Making Line Plots; U11 Solving Problems with Line Plot Data

description: A cube with side length 1 unit, called a unit cube, is said to have one cubic unit of volume, and can be used to measure volume.
skill list: U8 Understanding Volume and Unit Cubes

description: A solid figure which can be packed without gaps or overlaps using n unit cubes is said to have a volume of n cubic units.
skill list: U8 Understanding Volume and Unit Cubes

description: Measure volumes by counting unit cubes, using cubic cm, cubic in., cubic ft., and non-standard units.
skill list: U8 Counting Cubes to Find Volume

description: Find the volume of a right rectangular prism with whole-number edge lengths by packing it with unit cubes, and show that the volume is the same as multiplying the edge lengths or multiplying the height by the area of the base.
skill list: U8 Volume Formulas

description: Apply the formulas V = l × w × h and V = B × h for rectangular prisms to find volumes in real-world and mathematical problems.
skill list: U8 Volume Formulas; U8 Volume Word Problems

description: Recognize volume as additive; find volumes of solid figures composed of two non-overlapping right rectangular prisms.
skill list: U8 Volume of Composite Figures

description: Use a pair of perpendicular number lines (axes) to define a coordinate system; locate a point using an ordered pair of numbers (its coordinates).
skill list: U9 The Coordinate System; U9 Plotting and Reading Points

description: Represent real-world and mathematical problems by graphing points in the first quadrant of the coordinate plane, and interpret coordinate values of points in the context of the situation.
skill list: U9 Real-World Problems on the Coordinate Plane; U9 Graphing Patterns and Relationships

description: Understand that attributes belonging to a category of two-dimensional figures also belong to all subcategories of that category.
skill list: U10 Polygons and Their Attributes; U10 Classifying Triangles; U10 Shape Hierarchies

description: Classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties.
skill list: U10 Classifying Triangles; U10 Classifying Quadrilaterals; U10 Shape Hierarchies
